purpose: Generate one V9-only three-pose component-source panel whose facial action verbs correct the V25 internal visual preflight failure. It is source art only, never a runtime face sheet, CRIG, profile, binding, flash or physical-panel claim.
identity_invariants: retain the locked V9 open oval eye silhouette, black fill, one large white oval highlight and one small white diamond sparkle per eye
retain the locked V9 eye-pair scale, spacing, baseline, nose anchor and monochrome ink weight
do not introduce a new eye shape, iris, pupil, eyelash, colour, face outline, ear, whisker or whole-face card
all brows, mouth, cheeks and highlights are clean separately extractable source components inside a 200x200 safe face area
use no literal menu, microphone, battery, plug, lightning, waveform, cursor, punctuation, text, heart, star or emoji
use no external marks: all reading must come from the face

v25_failure_antipatterns.menu_active: must not read as worry, uncertainty, anger or generic confusion
v25_failure_antipatterns.recording_active: must not read as surprise, alarm or broadcast
v25_failure_antipatterns.charging_active: must not read as generic excitement, sleep or Daily

panel_contract: Generate one unbordered, unlabeled left-to-right row of exactly three same-scale faces: menu_active, recording_active, charging_active. The panel is source provenance only; later runtime may export only registered components and must perform each action through a deterministic component sequence.

poses.facial_action: Both brows stay low and composed rather than worried; the left brow is almost level while the right has a restrained friendly lift. Both legal highlights share a subtle same-direction attention bias. The mouth is a tiny closed, level decision mark with a barely raised center, never a downturned frown. Cheeks are compact and steady.
poses.later_choreography: one deterministic highlight scan left-to-center-to-right, then a brow-and-mouth decision landing

poses.static_read: quiet active listening with a ready acknowledgement
poses.facial_action: Both brows sit slightly lower and lean gently toward the center, not high and not arched in surprise. Legal highlights are centered and attentive. The mouth is a very small closed soft acknowledgement mark, like a quiet 'mm-hm', not an O and not a smile. Cheeks open only a little and remain calm.
poses.later_choreography: attention arrives first, then one tiny mouth acknowledgement, then a still listening hold

poses.facial_action: Both brows release outward and sit lower than an excited face. Legal highlights are centered and settled. The mouth is a broad but compact relaxed recovery smile, with no open shout shape. Cheeks lift subtly. The result is calm after receiving energy, not celebratory joy or sleep.
poses.later_choreography: neutral Daily face releases into the calmer brow and recovery smile, holds, then reverses exactly

machine_preconditions_before_owner_revie: source gate proves locked-V9-only lineage, identity invariants, no external marks and pairwise face-primary separation
component export retains exact locked V9 identity components and source-derived brows/mouth/cheeks only
browser and target PBM replay the same deterministic component plan at native 200x200
internal visual preflight evaluates unlabeled target holds plus causal playback and rejects any V25 failure read before an operator prompt
